episode_summary: In this episode, Julia Linquist discusses the challenges of balancing a high-performing real estate career with family life. Michael Opyd provides actionable insights on setting realistic goals, delegating tasks, and maintaining consistency to reduce stress and improve work-life balance. The conversation offers valuable strategies for agents looking to enhance their productivity while prioritizing personal well-being.
